parts.text: $ALLY Q3 2026: revenue $2.3B, +8% Y/Y, driven by dealer financial services and digital banking growth. Operating margin 24.3%; net earnings $433M. #earnings #banks
$PLTR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.3B, +96% Y/Y, driven by U.S. commercial revenue growth surpassing government revenue. Operating margin 46.9%. #earnings #software

$VOYA Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.0B, -5% Y/Y, with net earnings of $253M and an operating margin of 14.2%. Growth was supported by commercial momentum in Retirement and margin improvements in Employee Benefits. #earnings #insurance
$CLX Q1 FY27: revenue $1.9B, +33% Y/Y, driven by lapping prior-period lower shipments and the GOJO acquisition. Operating margin 10.9%. #earnings #consumer
$IMO Q3 2026: revenue $16.2B, +34% Y/Y, driven by higher marker prices and realizations for bitumen and synthetic crude. Operating margin 19.9%; operating cash flow $3.2B. #earnings #oil
$BCC Q3 2026: revenue $1.8B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher commodity prices in Building Materials Distribution. Operating margin 3.1%. #earnings #industrials
$ON Q3 2026: revenue $1.7B, +11% Y/Y, driven by higher demand in industrial and AI data center markets. Operating margin 22.0%; operating cash flow $516M. #earnings #semiconductors
$O Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +10% Y/Y, with an operating margin of 28.1% as property investments and steady leasing activity supported results. #earnings #REITs

$CWH Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, -12% Y/Y amid continued pressure on new vehicle margins. Operating margin -17.3% as the company accelerated cost-reduction initiatives to realign its cost base. #earnings #retail
$CC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +3% Y/Y, driven by pricing execution in Titanium Technologies and APM growth. Operating margin 14.4%. #earnings #materials
$ROKU Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, up 24% Y/Y, driven by advertising growth and higher streaming engagement. Operating margin reached 10.9% as operating expenses declined. #earnings #media
$FN Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +51% Y/Y, driven by broad-based demand across multiple programs and new product ramps. Operating margin 9.9%. #earnings #tech
